cut.v15-glam-caf-beer-therapy: Cut: a late craft-beer bar in an Old Town lane — fine, but nothing this coast does that a bar elsewhere does not; the glass lane keeps the Croatian-only wine bar and the two Pelješac cellars.

v-taj-mahal.name: Taj Mahal (Bosnian grill)
v-taj-mahal.verdict: Despite the name, a Bosnian grill: ćevapi, minced-meat fingers grilled over charcoal and served in lepinja flatbread with raw onion and ajvar, plus klepe, sogan dolma and burek. Honest Balkan cooking, not a theme park.
v-taj-mahal.signature: Ćevapi in lepinja with onion and ajvar.

v-barba.name: Barba
v-barba.verdict: Slow Dalmatian fast food: Adriatic fish in fast-food formats — an octopus burger, a fish taco, salted-cod croquettes. A counter and a handful of tables, walk-in.
